text: ここから　さきへは　いかせないぜ！

structure.jp: ここから　さきへは

patterns.name: 〜させる
patterns.explanation: Changing いく to いかせる turns 'go' into 'let someone go', and ない makes it 'not'. いかせない = 'I won't let you go'.

patterns.name: 〜ぜ
patterns.explanation: ぜ at the end of a sentence is rough, confident men's speech. いかせないぜ = 'I'm not letting you through!'
